data.summary:
Accomplished Technical Project Manager / Delivery Manager with 17+ years of progressive experience spanning software development, technical leadership, project management, and enterprise software delivery across BFSI, Insurance, Retail, and Logistics domains. PMP® and PSPO® certified with expertise in Agile delivery, PMO governance, stakeholder management, vendor coordination, and global program execution across USA, UK, India, and GCC regions.
Proven track record of delivering enterprise software programs on time and within budget while improving delivery predictability through KPI-driven governance, RAID management, and Agile best practices.
Strong technical understanding of Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, AWS, Kafka, CI/CD, Terraform, and .NET, enabling effective collaboration with architects, engineering teams, and DevOps teams throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
Leveraging AI-powered productivity tools including GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, and Claude to accelerate requirements analysis, user story creation, documentation, solution design discussions, code reviews, and overall delivery efficiency across Agile software programs. CAREER SNAPSHOT
Career progression from Software Developer / Software Engineer → Project Lead → Technical Project Manager →
Delivery Manager
Delivered enterprise software programs across Insurance, BFSI, Retail and Logistics with consistent focus on on-time
delivery, quality and governance
Managed cross-functional teams of 30+ members across Software Development, QA and DevOps, while collaborating
closely with Product Owners and Business stakeholders.
Led Agile, Scrum and Hybrid delivery programs with global stakeholders across USA, UK, India and GCC • Strong technical background in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, AWS, Kafka, CI/CD, Terraform, and .NET, enabling effective collaboration with architects, engineering teams, and DevOps teams throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
Extensive experience in Project Governance, PMO, Risk & Issue Management, Budget Tracking, Release Management
and Stakeholder Management
